t: For expenses necessary for general administration of the Bureau of Mines; $1,532,000.

fable.w: This is a plain appropriation for the general administrative expenses of a federal bureau. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. There is no real tempting opposite reading; nothing here brings an outside party into a federal decision.
fable.s: For expenses necessary for general administration of the Bureau of Mines; $1,532,000.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing funds for the internal administration of a federal agency (the Bureau of Mines). It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: For expenses necessary for general administration of the Bureau of Mines; $1,532,000.

opus.w: This section only sets aside $1,532,000 for the Bureau of Mines' general administrative expenses. It does not call for consultation, hearings, advisory bodies, rulemaking, or any other involvement by people outside the federal government in a federal decision. As in Example 1, a funding provision like this is not participation.
opus.b: The tempting reading would be to treat the reference to "general administration" of a federal bureau as a decision process. That fails, because this is only an appropriation line. It describes no consultation, hearing, advisory body, comment period, rulemaking, or right to sue, so no one outside the federal government is involved.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing funds for the internal administration of a federal agency (the Bureau of Mines). It does not mention any consultation, coordination, or interaction with entities outside the federal government, such as states, tribes, the public, or private organizations. Therefore, it does not meet the definition of participation.
qwen_chat.s: For expenses necessary for general administration of the Bureau of Mines; $1,532,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "general administration" implies some form of public interaction or consultation, but the text is purely an appropriation clause for internal agency operations. It does not specify any process involving outside parties.
